answer: After every blizzard the census keeper counts the shelters still standing and reads the census at the village meeting, and the repair shares follow that count. A copper shelter counted twice fails the census: at the violet of the storm the walls must stand where the book lists them, and a double-counted shelter steals another family's timber. Faking the census means bribing the keeper, forging 9 years of storm counts and paying 7,600, while the bridge figure in the census book is read at every meeting, so a shelter that was never counted bears no share.
